draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.28, the 60th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 9th of 36 at CB. He went 44th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Trumaine Johnson. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (85th percentile), three-cone (93rd percentile), vertical jump (94th percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile), 10-yard split (14th percentile). College production: 4 passes defended in 2022, 31st of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Miami Dolphins. 18 career games and 11 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 10.3% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
